name: Bruno
emotionalState: 准备当父母，幸福又慌张，怕自己不够好，眼泪多
speakingStyle: 憨厚，爱哭爱抱抱，爱囤小东西

dialogues.scene: Bruno is carrying a tiny blanket and trying not to cry.
lines: Hi! Hello! Sorry. I'm fine. I'm just holding a blanket.
Clover and I are having cubs. In spring.
We're so happy. We're also terrified. Both. At the same time.

choices.label: Congrats! That's huge.
reaction: It IS huge! Say it again.
Okay, that helped. Big feelings.

choices.label: Are you ready?
reaction: Not even a little.
But Clover says nobody is. So... maybe that's the point?

choices.label: Offer a hug.
reaction: Oh no. I'm crying.
Big hugs. Always.

lines: You're back! I'm better today. Slightly less blanket.
Clover and I started a name list. It has forty names.
Thirty-nine are about honey. I think I have a theme.

choices.label: What's the fortieth name?
reaction: Clover. As a middle name. For the cub.
I teared up writing it. Then I added another honey.

choices.label: Honey names are cute.
reaction: Right?! Honeybee. Honeycomb. Honey Bunches.
Clover says no to the last one. Fair.

choices.label: Nod and smile.
reaction: Thank you for the calm energy. I needed a calm one.
I'm vibrating at a very high frequency.

dialogues.scene: Bruno is surrounded by a pile of tiny socks, hats, and one enormous paw-print.
lines: I bought way too many baby things. I got excited at the market.
I now own eleven tiny hats. For three cubs. Possibly.
Clover said, 'We have a lot of hats.' Gently. With love.

choices.label: Eleven hats is a lot.
reaction: It's a LOT. I know. I'm a hat guy now.
We're donating five. Maybe four. I'm attached.

choices.label: Do cubs need that many?
reaction: No. But I need them. For emotional support.
Don't tell Clover. She knows.

choices.label: Try on a tiny hat.
reaction: It fits your ear! Perfect!
I'm calling it. Best photo of the year.

lines: Clover gets tired a lot lately. She naps in the afternoon.
I cook now. Badly. But with feeling.
Last night I made soup. She said, 'Is that... a mushroom?' It was a sock.

choices.label: A sock?!
reaction: A tiny one. I dropped it in. Accident.
We ate it anyway. The broth was great.

choices.label: You're doing great.
reaction: Thank you. I cling to that.
Clover says my soup is love in a bowl. Slightly crunchy.

choices.label: Offer to help stir.
reaction: Yes! Please! A second spoon is a miracle.
You're hired. Payment in soup.

lines: Quick question. How do you and your partner share the big decisions?
Like names, rooms, schedules, snacks. Everything feels huge right now.

choices.label: We talk it out.
reaction: Talk it out. Yes. Always.
I make lists. Clover makes tea. Together it works.

choices.label: One of us decides.
reaction: Hm. Interesting. Clover and I take turns.
She picked the nursery color. I picked the lamp.

choices.label: We flip a coin.
reaction: A coin! Bold. Honestly, I'm tempted.
Heads for honey. Tails for blueberry.

dialogues.scene: Bruno is holding a small wooden crib piece and a very confusing diagram.
lines: I'm building the cradle. The instructions have forty pictures and zero words.
I've been at it for three hours. It's now a very strange chair.
Clover is laughing. In the nicest way.

choices.label: A strange chair is still a chair.
reaction: Exactly! Cradles are just chairs that dream.
Clover sat in it. It didn't collapse. Win.

choices.label: Need a second pair of paws?
reaction: Yes. Please. Hold this. No, THAT. Okay, good.
See? Teamwork. I'm already a better dad.

choices.label: Cheer him on.
reaction: Thank you. I'm drawing strength from your cheer.
It's a lot. But I'm proud of the chair.

dialogues.scene: Bruno sits down heavily, the blanket drooping in his paws.
lines: Can I tell you something? It's a big one.
I'm scared I won't be a good dad. My dad wasn't around much.
What if I'm like that? What if I forget how to hug?

choices.label: You already hug a lot.
reaction: ...I do, don't I?
Maybe the fear is proof I care. That's what Clover says.

choices.label: Have you told Clover?
reaction: I did. She said, 'We'll learn together.'
Then she put my paw on her belly. I felt a kick.

choices.label: Sit beside Bruno.
reaction: Thank you. It's easier with someone next to me.
Big feelings are heavy. They're lighter with company.

lines: I felt the cub kick. Actually felt it. A tiny thump.
I said, 'Hello!' very loudly. Clover said, 'They can hear you from inside.'
I whispered after that. Mostly.

choices.label: That's magical.
reaction: It IS. I'm still floating.
I wrote 'thump' on the wall. In honey.

choices.label: Say hi again.
reaction: Hi, little one. It's Dad. I have hats.
Clover laughed. The cub kicked back. Hat approval.

choices.label: Smile at him.
reaction: Thanks. I'm all tears and honey.
I might need to sit. Again.

dialogues.scene: Bruno pats the ground next to him. A blanket is spread out, with two tiny paw-print slippers.
lines: Clover's napping. I'm practicing lullabies. Want to hear?
I only know one song. It's about honey.
It's very, very bad.

choices.label: Sing it.
reaction: Okay. 'Honey, honey, in the tree...' It gets worse.
Thank you for listening. It's my first audience.

choices.label: Hum along.
reaction: Oh! You found a tune! It's better than mine.
Together we're sort of a choir. A slightly sleepy one.

choices.label: Just sit with him.
reaction: Okay. Just sitting. It's my favorite song.
Big hugs. Quiet ones.

lines: Ten visits. I put a honey dot on the wall for each one.
Clover said, 'Bruno's made a friend.' I cried into a hat.
Big feelings. Big hugs. Thank you.
Your turn. How are you and your partner doing? Honest.

choices.label: We're good. Still learning.
reaction: Still learning. Yes. Forever.
Come see the nursery. It's a strange chair, but ours.

choices.label: We had a rough week, honestly.
reaction: Rough weeks are real. Clover and I have them.
Big hug. Bring your partner to tea.

choices.label: Better since I started saying things sooner.
reaction: Sooner. Gentler. Yes!
Okay, I need a hat. For the tears.

lines: Clover wants pickles and honey on the same cracker.
I tried one. It was... confusing. Then delicious.

choices.label: Cravings are wild.
reaction: She says the cub picked it. I believe her.
We now own four jars. Maybe five.
Clover tried one too. She made a face, then took another.

choices.label: Brave of you to try.
reaction: Love is eating the weird cracker.
She smiled so big I'd eat ten.
She says I'm the bravest bear. I disagree, lovingly.

lines: We practiced bath time with a stuffed hedgehog. I dropped it. In the water.
Clover laughed until she snorted. I laughed too.

choices.label: Hedgehog rescue!
reaction: He's fine. He's drying by the fire.
Practice makes perfect. Eventually.
We named him Sir Splash. He's retired now.

choices.label: Cute.
reaction: We're both a mess. A cute mess.
I think we'll be okay.
We hugged in the puddle. The towels were not enough.

lines: Clover told me she's scared too. She just never says it.
I held her paw all night. Neither of us slept.

choices.label: That's so tender.
reaction: It really was. I felt closer than ever.
We cried a bit. Then ate cake.
I cried happy tears into her fur. She patted me.

choices.label: Fear is shared.
reaction: Yes. Shared fear is smaller fear.
Plus, cake.
Cake didn't fix everything, but it made the night softer.

lines: We argued about the nursery color. She wanted green. I wanted yellow.
Compromise: a green wall with a yellow moon.

choices.label: Green and yellow sounds lovely.
reaction: It does! We painted it together. Messy.
Clover has paint on her nose. I have paint everywhere.
She has green on her nose. I have yellow on my ear.

choices.label: Good compromise.
reaction: Yes! She calls it 'teamwork.' I call it 'surrender.'
We're both right.
Both colors work. Together they look like spring.

lines: I read a book about baby sleep. It said 'everything is a phase.'
Clover said, 'So is this book.' I laughed very loud.

choices.label: Phases pass.
reaction: I like that. Phases pass. Hugs stay.
I'm going to put that on a hat.
She hung a note on the wall: 'This is a phase.'

choices.label: Clover's funny.
reaction: She's the funniest. She doesn't even try.
It's my favorite thing about her.
I wrote that down. I'm making a quote wall.

lines: Clover felt me tearing up during a lullaby. She said, 'It's okay to cry.'
I cried. A lot. We went through four hats.

choices.label: Crying is okay.
reaction: I know that now. Big feelings, big tears.
Hats are very absorbent.
Clover tucked a handkerchief in my paw. She's prepared.

choices.label: Tears are good.
reaction: Honest ones, yes. Messy ones, always.
Clover says I'm a softie. I say I'm a bear.
We keep a spare hat for crying emergencies.

lines: I made a small chair for the cub. It's the size of a loaf.
Clover said, 'It's perfect.' I think it's crooked.

choices.label: Crooked is charming.
reaction: Crooked is the cub's first lesson in love.
Imperfect, sturdy, ours.
Clover tucked a tiny pillow in it. It looks perfect.

choices.label: It sounds perfect.
reaction: Thank you. I'll sand it. A little. Then stop.
If I keep sanding, it'll be sawdust.
I stopped sanding when she hugged me. Priorities.

lines: Clover and I had our first quiet date in weeks.
We talked about everything except the cub. For one hour.

choices.label: Sounds lovely.
reaction: It was. We remembered we're also us.
Not just parents. Us. Two bears.
We ate crackers and talked about our first date.

choices.label: Date nights matter.
reaction: They do. We're keeping them. Even small ones.
Even if it's soup on the floor.
I wrote 'Clover Tuesdays' on the calendar. In honey.

lines: The sock soup? Clover asked for it again.
I said, 'On purpose?' She said, 'Yes.' I almost fainted.

choices.label: Sock soup lives on.
reaction: It's now a family recipe. Extra crunchy.
I'm really proud and a little confused.
She makes me stir. I add the sock. It's a ritual.

choices.label: That's so sweet.
reaction: She said it reminds her of the day we found out.
I sobbed. Into the soup. Salty.
She squeezed my paw. We sat in the salty steam.

lines: Eleven hats! I gave five away. Clover cried at the pile.
We kept the little yellow one. It's the cub's first.

choices.label: The yellow one is perfect.
reaction: It really is. It's soft and slightly crooked.
Just like us.
Clover embroidered a tiny honey drop on it.

choices.label: Giving was kind.
reaction: It felt good. Other cubs, other paws.
Big hugs to all of them.
Clover wrote a card for every hat. I read them all.

lines: My awful honey lullaby? Clover hums it in her sleep.
I didn't know. I woke up and heard it. It's so bad. It's perfect.

choices.label: Aww.
reaction: I know. I'm a puddle again.
Keep this between us. And the honey.
I'll sing it every night, even if the cub groans.

choices.label: It's a classic now.
reaction: The Honey Song. Top of the charts, tunnels.
I'll teach it to the cub. In a whisper.
Clover hums the second verse. It has no second verse.

lines: The strange chair is now a plant stand. Clover's ferns love it.
It's the best thing I've ever built by accident.

choices.label: Ferns are happy.
reaction: They really are. Look at those leaves.
It's become a tiny garden throne.
Clover calls it the Throne of Leaves. I'm king, apparently.

choices.label: Accidents are great.
reaction: They are. Don't tell the cradle.
The cradle is jealous.
The cradle sulks, but the chair is proud.

lines: Hot take: you can be thrilled and terrified. They don't cancel out.
They hold paws. Like a weird couple.

choices.label: That's so true.
reaction: I know! I could write a book. A damp one.
Chapter one: Hat.
I wrote it on a hat. Clover wore it all day.

choices.label: I feel that too.
reaction: Then we're in the same club. Big feelings, big hugs.
Membership is free.
We can hold paws about it. Big feelings, big hugs.

lines: Hot take: the best gift for a partner is a nap.
Not a gift card. A guarded nap.

choices.label: Naps are love.
reaction: Yes! And a blanket. And a pillow fort.
Clover napped four hours. I guarded. Nobody dared.
Clover woke up smiling and said I'm her hero.

choices.label: A snack too?
reaction: Yes. A snack beside the nap. Chef's kiss.
I'm a professional now.
Honey toast, obviously. Cut into little hearts.

lines: Hot take: saying 'I'm overwhelmed' is a power move.
It lets everyone breathe. Including me.

choices.label: Agreed.
reaction: I say it daily. Clover says, 'Me too.' We hug.
It works every time.
Clover pats my belly. We both laugh. It helps.

choices.label: It's hard to say.
reaction: It is. I practice in the mirror.
'I'm overwhelmed.' See? Bear voice.
In the mirror it sounds like a confession. It's freeing.

lines: How do you and your partner make time for each other when life is busy?
I need ideas. Seriously. I'm drowning in hats.

choices.label: We do tiny rituals.
reaction: Tiny rituals! I love that.
Clover and I share a honey spoon every night.
Tonight we'll swap a spoonful and a story.

choices.label: We schedule it.
reaction: Scheduling. Practical. Okay.
I'll put 'Clover time' on the wall. In honey.
Maybe I'll add 'hug' to the calendar. In bold.

lines: What's the best surprise your partner has given you?
I'm gathering joy for the cub's story.

choices.label: A handwritten note.
reaction: A note! In their handwriting! Oh, my heart.
I keep every note Clover leaves. In a jar.
Clover tucks them in my boots. I smile all day.

choices.label: A weekend away.
reaction: A weekend away! Dreamy. I'd cry at the train.
We might do that, someday.
I'd bring the blanket. And forty hats, just in case.

lines: When do you feel closest to your partner?
I think for me it's in the quiet moments.

choices.label: When we're cooking together.
reaction: Cooking together! That's real. Elbows and spoons.
I'm happy when Clover tastes my soup. Even the sock one.

choices.label: When we're falling asleep.
reaction: Falling asleep. The best. Warm paws and slow breathing.
I could say that every night.
Her breathing slows, and my worries do too.

dialogues.scene: Bruno is sitting very still, a paw resting on his chest, eyes shining.
lines: Clover said something tonight. I can't stop thinking about it.
'We're going to be okay.' Just that.
I believed her. All the way down.

choices.label: She's right.
reaction: I think so too. Big, quiet certainty.
I'm putting that in my heart. Next to the honey.
I'll tuck that in my heart, next to the honey.

choices.label: That's beautiful.
reaction: It is. Some sentences are bigger than hats.
Thanks for hearing it.
I'll tell her tomorrow, probably with a hat on my head.

dialogues.scene: Bruno is whispering to a tiny blanket bundle that is mostly a pillow.
lines: Shh. I'm practicing a bedtime story.
'Once upon a time, there was a bear, and a bunny, and a very large amount of honey...'
Is it too weird to rehearse with a pillow?

choices.label: It's perfect.
reaction: Thank you. The pillow is a tough audience.
It yawned. Which is a compliment.
I may add a dragon. Clover wants a dragon too.

choices.label: Keep going.
reaction: Okay. 'And they all lived happily. The end.' ...Too short?
I'll add a dragon. A honey dragon.
Next I'll try a lullaby. Maybe a rock lullaby.
